paths.description: Homepage and mixed catalog sections; represents discovery, global chrome, ads, performance and search entry.
Fanzine listing; represents dense catalog/card template and mobile navigation.
Representative content detail; covers metadata, reading journey, comments and catalog-to-detail completion.
Primary form flow; covers labels, input assistance, validation, error announcement and mobile layout.

findings.summary: The fixed dark theme does not declare its color scheme.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition computed-style probe reported colorScheme "normal" while the page uses a dark background; native contact controls remain light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: dark (or light dark if both themes are supported) and theme controls consistently.

findings.summary: Header motion remains enabled when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found a 0.2s transition on the Headroom header under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or shorten non-essential header transitions inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Navigation between catalog and detail pages swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: DOM and platform probes found no View Transition integration on this multi-page catalog; representative route navigation is a full abrupt swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin catalog-to-detail navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Advertising occupies a disproportionate share of the first viewport.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show a large empty/ad slot before page content, and the home HAR attributes requests to numerous ad-tech origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse empty ad slots, reserve only responsive ad space, and move nonessential advertising below the primary content.

findings.summary: Desktop ad iframes force severe horizontal overflow on mobile.
findings.evidence: At 360px, layout measured 749px scroll width on home/listing/contact (and one run reached 1920px). The overflow probe identified 728px ad iframes extending to x=749.
findings.suggestedFix: Constrain ad containers and iframes with max-inline-size:100%, use responsive ad units, and clip only as a last-resort fallback.

findings.summary: Lab LCP and CLS miss good thresholds.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.9s and CLS 0.138; the contact mobile layout independently observed CLS 0.0796.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP image, reserve all media/ad space, and prevent late ad insertion from shifting content.

findings.summary: Most images omit intrinsic dimensions and ads shift layout.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 51 of 52 images without width/height attributes; Lighthouse measured CLS 0.138.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height or aspect-ratio for thumbnails, hero images and ad slots before loading.

findings.summary: The homepage transfers 4.78 MB across 113 requests.
findings.evidence: HAR summary recorded 4,777,874 transferred bytes, including 3.80 MB images and 62 font requests; Lighthouse estimated 1.09s render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive thumbnails, subset/self-host fonts, reduce font variants, and inline or defer noncritical CSS and scripts.

findings.summary: Unused CSS and JavaScript add avoidable work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 69 KiB unused CSS and 86 KiB unused JavaScript; third-party ad scripts dominate the script surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused plugin assets per template and load ad/analytics code only where and when needed.

findings.summary: The search field and decorative hero image lack accessible naming.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt for the hero; probes found the search text input and icon-only submit input without labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visible or programmatic search label and alt=""/presentation semantics for decorative images (descriptive alt only when informative).

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy skips levels and uses multiple page-level headings.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed heading-order on repeated h3 section labels; recon found eight h1 elements on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page h1 and a sequential h2/h3 structure that reflects catalog sections; retain native focus outlines.

findings.summary: The viewport disables pinch zoom and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The viewport is maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no; the listing probe counted 129 of 168 interactive elements below 24px in at least one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions and enlarge compact links/controls to comfortable touch targets.

findings.summary: A third-party ad script repeatedly fails in the console.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded repeated HTTP 403 failures for https://js.ademon.net/t/017/844/a80017844.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or conditionally load the failing integration and monitor third-party load failures.

findings.summary: Structured data is present but social preview metadata is absent.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found JSON-LD but no Open Graph or Twitter card meta tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Add per-template og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url and corresponding Twitter card fields.

findings.summary: Core transport security headers and cookie flags are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers found no HSTS, CSP or nosniff; all five first-party cookies lacked Secure and four used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS and nosniff, deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, and mark HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest suitable SameSite policy.

findings.summary: The page loads a broad advertising and analytics footprint before consent.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 15 third-party origins and Google Analytics; Lighthouse found five third-party cookies, while the HAR attributed 105 of 113 requests to non-main origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate nonessential analytics/ad storage behind consent, and proxy or self-host essential resources where practical.

findings.summary: Browser isolation and permission policies are absent.
findings.evidence: No frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy was present, and no CSP frame-ancestors fallback exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, a strict Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Contact fields omit autocomplete assistance.
findings.evidence: The contact probe showed blank autocomplete values for name and email fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete="name" and autocomplete="email" while preserving the clear Japanese labels.

findings.summary: Thumbnails are substantially oversized for their rendered slots.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 18 oversized images and 51 images without srcset; 1280px sources render at about 174px.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate width-specific WebP/AVIF thumbnails and emit srcset/sizes for each card layout.

findings.summary: Nonessential ad and analytics work starts during the critical load.
findings.evidence: The HAR captured 105 non-main-origin requests and multiple parser/async ad integrations during initial navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay nonessential third-party fetching until consent, visibility or idle time, and remove duplicate vendor bootstraps.

findings.summary: Third-party fonts and advertising are disproportionate to content value.
findings.evidence: The homepage loads 62 fonts, 15 third-party origins and 4.44 MB attributed outside the main origin definition.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a small system/self-hosted font stack, set a vendor budget, and remove ad-tech chains that do not measurably support the core experience.
